description: core's villager pass-by corpus (conformance/villagers/pass-by.json, PL.pass-by-core) through the passBy.* rows, each op one call of its row, as core's reference runner (pass-by/pass-by-corpus.ts) makes one core call.

cases.name: pass-by: the contract the passBy.contract row states

sideFrames.unreal: left-handed, z up; core (x, z) = Unreal (X, Y); +1 = Unreal's Left vector (−Dir.Y, Dir.X) = the walker's RIGHT
sideFrames.godot: right-handed, y up; core (x, z) = Godot (x, z); +1 = the walker's RIGHT
sideFrames.unity: left-handed, y up; core (x, z) = Unity (x, z); +1 = the walker's LEFT
sideFrames.babylon: left-handed, y up; core (x, z) = Babylon (x, z); +1 = the walker's LEFT

cases.name: pass-by floor: floor: Unreal's bodies (villager 0.34 m, player 0.42 m) and the 0.2 m gap
pass-by floor: floor: other bodies
pass-by floor: floor: a radius that is not a positive number is the default
pass-by guard: guard: dead on at a standing player, inside the band: it edges round on a side it chooses
pass-by guard: guard: told the other side, it edges that way against a drift the first way
pass-by guard: guard: dead on with no side yet and a drift: the side it drifts to
pass-by guard: guard: inside the floor already: its velocity opens the gap
pass-by guard: guard: sliding past the body: the part along it is kept
pass-by guard: guard: a player walking into a villager that barely moves: it backs off at their pace
pass-by guard: guard: CONTROL: the same player 2 m off is not closing fast enough to act on yet
pass-by guard: guard: a player rushing at it faster than it can walk: it backs off at its top speed
pass-by guard: guard: a runner (4.5 m/s) at a player 0.45 m off its line
pass-by guard: guard: on top of the player, walking: out against its own heading
pass-by guard: guard: on top of the player, standing: out along +x
pass-by guard: guard: other bodies: the floor moves with the radii
pass-by guard: guard: CONTROL: walking away from the player is untouched
pass-by guard: guard: CONTROL: 3 m off, walking straight at the player, is untouched yet
pass-by guard: guard: CONTROL: a pass that keeps a 0.3 m gap is untouched
pass-by plan: plan: a standing player 1.5 m ahead, 0.2 m to its +1 side: it steps to −1, away from them
pass-by plan: plan: a player dead on its line: +1
pass-by plan: plan: a player 0.2 m to its −1 side: +1
pass-by plan: plan: a player walking toward it is planned round where the two meet
pass-by plan: plan: the meeting is looked for at most 4 s ahead
pass-by plan: plan: a player walking away ahead of it is planned where they stand
pass-by plan: plan: a player walking toward it slower than 0.2 m/s is planned where they stand
pass-by plan: plan: the side away from them has no room: the other side
pass-by plan: plan: no room on either side (a doorway, a lane): no step aside
pass-by plan: plan: a player walking across into the point away from them: the other side
pass-by plan: plan: other bodies: the lane and the step out move with the radii
pass-by plan: plan: a heading that is not along an axis
pass-by plan: plan: the path's last point is the goal: the goal beyond the player
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: 3 m ahead is not in its way yet
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: a player behind it
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: a player 0.5 m ahead is the guard's, not a step aside
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: a player 1.2 m off its line
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: exactly the lane's half-width off its line
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: a player beside a goal it is about to reach
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: a villager slower than 0.4 m/s does not plan
pass-by plan: plan: REFUSED: no path
pass-by round: round: a first leg back across the player goes round them, on the villager's side
pass-by round: round: turning the other way round
pass-by round: round: other bodies
pass-by round: round: CONTROL: a first leg heading away from the player goes straight
pass-by round: round: CONTROL: a first leg passing 1.2 m from the player goes straight
pass-by round: round: CONTROL: standing on the player's centre: no way round is defined
pass-by replay: replay: a standing player on its line
pass-by replay: replay: a standing player dead on its line
pass-by replay: replay: head-on: the player walks toward it
pass-by replay: replay: crossing: the player walks across its line
pass-by replay: replay: overtaking: the player walks the same way, slower
pass-by replay: replay: a player in a doorway, who then walks on
pass-by replay: replay: a player standing in a doorway throughout
pass-by replay: replay: a lane with an alcove, the player walking down it: it steps into the alcove and waits until they are by

pass-by replay: replay: two villagers in file, toward a player who walks toward them
